notes.title: One-year anniversary of BIOMORPH
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783070/ed467758d7d2be6bdf08b8c13201db095266b6c4.png[/img]

On April 5th, we’re marking the [b]one-year anniversary of BIOMORPH[/b]’s launch on Steam!

We couldn’t be prouder of what we’ve created with our incredible development team. Over the past year, your feedback has been invaluable, leading to a host of improvements in version 2.0:

[list]
[*]Enjoy the freedom to change your Biomorph loadout anywhere in the game.
[*]Explore our completely revamped S.A.F.E. upgrade, introducing an exciting new travel method.
[*]Navigate effortlessly with landmarks marking every room on the minimap.
[*]Benefit from enhanced accessibility options that make the game easier to play, if needed.
[*]Dive into the action in three new languages.
[*]Experience smoother gameplay thanks to significant performance optimizations.
[/list]

We’re also thrilled to share that BIOMORPH was nominated for [b]Game of the Year[/b] at the [b]Canadian Game Awards[/b]. It was a proud moment for our small Quebec studio!

Thank you again for your amazing support throughout the year. If you’re enjoying the game, please consider leaving a positive review. It truly helps us out.

And if you haven’t picked up BIOMORPH yet, here’s some exciting news: as part of our anniversary celebration, the game will be featured as a [b]Steam Daily Deal on Saturday, April 5th, at a 35% discount[/b]... the biggest yet! It’s the perfect opportunity to join the adventure, have some fun, and share your thoughts.

notes.title: Update notes for Patch 1.4.26559
notes.content:
[h1]Release notes - Patch 1.4.26559[/h1]

[h2]CHANGES[/h2]

[list]
[*]Accessibility: Introduced a new section within the Pause Menu specifically for accessibility settings.
[*]Accessibility: Added option to disable losing money on death.
[*]Accessibility: Added a game-wide option to increase damage output to help players in combat.
[*]Accessibility: Added a game-wide defense enhancement option to reduce incoming damage.
[*]FPS Limit Options: Introduced adjustable frame rate limits with settings for 30, 60, 120, 144, 240 FPS, and an unlimited option.
[*]Menu Navigation Improvement: Enhanced menu navigation to automatically return to the last visited screen upon reopening the menu.
[*]Quit Game Confirmation: Added a confirmation step for quitting the game to prevent accidental exits.
[*]Return to Title Confirmation: Added a confirmation step before returning to the title screen to prevent accidental exits.
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]

[list]
[*]Alarm VFX: Fixed a bug where alarm visual effects would remain active when re-entering the Core.
[*]Balance: Reduced the damage output from Gorgerzer to improve gameplay balance.
[*]Biomorph: The progress value in the menu is now correctly capped.
[*]Biomorph: Addressed an issue where Muttler's dash up attack could become stuck.
[*]Biomorph: Corrected the damage output for Fubirang at rank 2.
[*]Biomorph: Fixed a bug causing Parasling to lose charges at rank 3.
[*]Camera Shake: Resolved an issue where the camera would continue shaking after returning to the title screen.
[*]Chips: Fixed the Ferrox Specter chip to ensure it triggers an additional bounce at rank 3.
[*]Dialogue: Fixed a bug causing infinite dialogue triggers with certain NPCs.
[*]Dustborough DNA Door: Fixed an issue preventing the DNA door in Dustborough from unlocking correctly.
[*]Falling Ground: Fixed an issue where interactions would not trigger correctly while attacking.
[*]Map: Added a missing Aberror to the Sentinel Complex's golden room conditions.
[*]Memento: Resolved an issue where the Positive Solenoid Memento was not functioning as intended when used with a Ferrox Field chip to prevent damage.
[*]Menu: Resolved an issue where the controller remap option was not being correctly disabled when no controller is connected.
[*]Out of Bounds: Addressed an out-of-bounds error occurring when returning to the title screen and reloading a game.
[*]Respawn: Corrected the respawn position of Oddwing to prevent spawning under spike pits.
[*]Scargatos: Added missing Scargatos in Mémé's house that were not appearing as intended.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for Patch 1.1.26426
notes.content:
[b]BIOMORPH [/b]has been on the market for nearly a week, and we're excited to bring you a series of quality of life improvements and bug fixes. Before anything else, we want to express our profound gratitude for the fantastic response to the game. Witnessing your support and feedback over these past 6 days has been incredible. Now, without any more delay, let's dive into the details of patch 1.1.

[h1]Release notes - Patch 1.1.26426[/h1]

[h2]CHANGES[/h2]

[list]
[*]It is now possible to quit to desktop from the pause screen.
[*]Added option to disable camera shake from the pause screen.
[*]Added option to return to the last S.A.F.E. from the pause screen.
[*]Added sprint on Harlo and Biomorph forms by holding the dodge button.
[*]Added Screenshot Pin ability in the inventory screen with description on how to use the feature. Screenshot pinning on the map screen was underused and people often didn’t even know the feature existed.
[*]The Architect will now give you hints about where to find building blueprints.
[*]Blueprints for community spaces now look different from those for buildings, making them easier to tell apart.
[*]Save games from the demo can now be used in the full game.
[*]Added additional landmarks on the Sentinel Complex map to improve navigation.
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed a case where the [b]Force of Nature[/b] achievement would not unlock.
[*]Fixed a case where the [b]Archaeo Afficionado[/b] achievement would not unlock.
[*]Fixed a case where the [b]Harlo the Builder[/b] achievement would not unlock.
[*]Fixed some typos in French.
[*]Fixed multiple soft locks.
[*]Fixed multiple golden room conditions.
[/list]

notes.title: Teaser Demo Update #2
notes.content:
Attention BIOMORPH enthusiasts! Our team recently attended PAX West, and we're thrilled to share our experience and some exciting news. During the event, attendees got an exclusive sneak-peek at the enhanced version of the BIOMORPH demo, now boasting a highly-anticipated feature - the [b]BIOMORPH Arsenal[/b].

With the BIOMORPH Arsenal, players can now freely transform into any biomorphed creature they've previously encountered, allowing for a deeper and more dynamic gameplay experience. Once players biomorph into a specific creature a set number of times, that creature becomes available for selection in their arsenal. Players can equip up to four distinct creatures, paving the way for thrilling monster-versus-monster battles and unlocking new avenues for exploration and discovery.

So now that PAX is over, we are giving you this new build to try out. We're eager to hear your thoughts on this update! Join the conversation on the Steam discussion board or connect with us directly on our Discord server. Happy gaming!

[h1]Teaser Demo Update #2 Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Introducing the BIOMORPH Arsenal: Transform freely into any creature you've previously biomorphed into!
[*]Discover updated hidden secrets within the demo (can you find the scargato?).
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Enhanced the Toroth's attack for a more satisfying experience.
[*]Revised and updated all text and dialogues in the teaser.
[/list]

The forthcoming significant demo update will introduce a proper official game demo where you'll be able to try out the different mechanics offered in the game! Follow us on Steam or on our other social platforms to get notified upon its release.

notes.title: Teaser Demo Update #1
notes.content:
Hello Dreamers, we just pushed [b]Update #1 for the Teaser Demo[/b]!

We added some new content to the build, fixed some issues and added a few requested features, such as being able to skip the cutscenes! You can find below what is new in this update!

[h1]Teaser Demo Update #1 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added support for the Steam Deck!
[*]Expanded the map that you can explore. The original layout was pretty straight-forward (it's the first zone and tutorial), but we added hidden rooms for more exploration. Can you find them?
[*]Added a stats screen at the end of the demo to display how much of the demo you completed. Did you miss any secrets during your playthrough? You'll find out at the end of the demo!
[*]It is now possible to skip cutscenes and conversations.
[*]It is now possible to pogo jump enemies using down + jump button.
[*]It is now possible to remap the Pause and Menu keyboard keys.
[*]Updated boss battle music.
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Modified impact VFX for better visibility.
[*]Enemies pushback has been modified.
[*]Healing efficiency has been increased.
[/list]

A quick reminder that we have a [b]Kickstarter[/b] coming soon! You can head over here to be notified when the campaign goes live:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/luciddreamsstudio/biomorph-become-your-enemy-in-a-dark-metroidvania]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/luciddreamsstudio/biomorph-become-your-enemy-in-a-dark-metroidvania[/url]

If you love our project, [u][b]spread the word[/b][/u]! That's the best way to help us out!
